question: 상품 유형별 실효율을 높은 순으로

question: 민원 유형별 평균 처리 소요일수
gold_sql: SELECT cd.CD_NM AS ctgy, AVG(julianday(substr(t.CMPL_DT,1,4) || '-' || substr(t.CMPL_DT,5,2) || '-' || substr(t.CMPL_DT,7,2)) - julianday(substr(t.RCPT_DT,1,4) || '-' || substr(t.RCPT_DT,5,2) || '-' || substr(t.RCPT_DT,7,2))) AS avg_days FROM TB_CS_TCKT t JOIN TB_COMM_CD cd ON cd.CD_GRP = 'TCKT_CTGY' AND cd.CD = t.CTGY_CD WHERE t.CMPL_DT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cd.CD_NM ORDER BY avg_days DESC

gold_sql: SELECT b.BRCH_NM, AVG(t.MON_PRM) AS avg_prm FROM TB_CTRT t JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = t.AGNT_ID JOIN TB_BRCH b ON b.BRCH_CD = a.BRCH_CD GROUP BY b.BRCH_NM HAVING AVG(t.MON_PRM) > (SELECT AVG(MON_PRM) FROM TB_CTRT) ORDER BY avg_prm DESC

question: 상품 유형별로 계약이 가장 많은 모집 채널은 어디야?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT p.PROD_TYP_CD AS typ, t.CHNL_CD AS chnl, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_CTRT t JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = t.PROD_CD GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD, t.CHNL_CD), m AS (SELECT typ, MAX(cnt) AS mx FROM x GROUP BY typ) SELECT ct.CD_NM AS prod_typ, cc.CD_NM AS chnl, x.cnt FROM x JOIN m ON m.typ = x.typ AND m.mx = x.cnt JOIN TB_COMM_CD ct ON ct.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP' AND ct.CD = x.typ JOIN TB_COMM_CD cc ON cc.CD_GRP = 'CHNL' AND cc.CD = x.chnl ORDER BY x.cnt DESC

question: 작년 상반기 대비 올해 상반기 신계약 증감률은?
gold_sql: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260630' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) - SUM(CASE WHEN CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250630' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250630' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS growth_rate FROM TB_CTRT

question: 보험금 청구를 3건 이상 한 고객 상위 10명과 청구 건수

question: 각 지점에서 모집 실적 1위인 설계사를 알려줘
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT a.BRCH_CD, a.AGNT_ID, a.AGNT_NM, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_CTRT t JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = t.AGNT_ID GROUP BY a.BRCH_CD, a.AGNT_ID, a.AGNT_NM), m AS (SELECT BRCH_CD, MAX(cnt) AS mx FROM x GROUP BY BRCH_CD) SELECT b.BRCH_NM, x.AGNT_NM, x.cnt FROM x JOIN m ON m.BRCH_CD = x.BRCH_CD AND m.mx = x.cnt JOIN TB_BRCH b ON b.BRCH_CD = x.BRCH_CD ORDER BY x.cnt DESC

question: 지급액 상위 10% 청구 건의 평균 이상징후 점수는?
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT PAY_AMT, FRAUD_SCR FROM TB_CLM WHERE CLM_STAT_CD IN ('30','50') ORDER BY PAY_AMT DESC LIMIT (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 0.1 AS INTEGER) FROM TB_CLM WHERE CLM_STAT_CD IN ('30','50'))) SELECT AVG(FRAUD_SCR) AS avg_fraud FROM r

question: 민원을 2건 이상 제기한 고객의 평균 계약 건수
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT CUST_ID FROM TB_CS_TCKT GROUP BY CUST_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), k AS (SELECT t.CUST_ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_CTRT t WHERE t.CUST_ID IN (SELECT CUST_ID FROM c) GROUP BY t.CUST_ID) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_ctrt FROM k

question: 부활한 계약의 상품 유형별 건수와 평균 부활 횟수
gold_sql: SELECT cd.CD_NM AS typ, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(t.RVIV_CNT) AS avg_rviv FROM TB_CTRT t JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = t.PROD_CD JOIN TB_COMM_CD cd ON cd.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP' AND cd.CD = p.PROD_TYP_CD WHERE t.CTRT_STAT_CD = '05' GROUP BY cd.CD_NM ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: 최근 1년 청구 건수가 직전 1년보다 늘어난 청구 유형은?
gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT CLM_TYP_CD, SUM(CASE WHEN CLM_DT BETWEEN '20250825' AND '20260824' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN CLM_DT BETWEEN '20240825' AND '20250824' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prv FROM TB_CLM GROUP BY CLM_TYP_CD) SELECT cd.CD_NM AS typ, a.cur, a.prv FROM a JOIN TB_COMM_CD cd ON cd.CD_GRP = 'CLM_TYP' AND cd.CD = a.CLM_TYP_CD WHERE a.cur > a.prv ORDER BY (a.cur - a.prv) DESC

question: 담보 가입금액 합계가 계약의 총가입금액을 넘는 계약은 몇 건이야?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT v.CTRT_NO, SUM(v.INSD_AMT) AS s FROM TB_CVRG v GROUP BY v.CTRT_NO) x JOIN TB_CTRT t ON t.CTRT_NO = x.CTRT_NO WHERE x.s > t.TOT_INSD_AMT

question: 누적 납입보험료가 가장 많은 고객 10명
gold_sql: SELECT t.CUST_ID, SUM(p.PAY_AMT) AS total FROM TB_PAY p JOIN TB_CTRT t ON t.CTRT_NO = p.CTRT_NO GROUP BY t.CUST_ID ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

question: 채널별 계약 유지율을 높은 순으로 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT cd.CD_NM AS chnl, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.CTRT_STAT_CD IN ('01','05') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS persistency FROM TB_CTRT t JOIN TB_COMM_CD cd ON cd.CD_GRP = 'CHNL' AND cd.CD = t.CHNL_CD GROUP BY cd.CD_NM ORDER BY persistency DESC

question: 연체가 3회 이상 발생한 계약의 실효율은?
gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CTRT_NO FROM TB_PAY WHERE DLQ_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY CTRT_NO HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS lapse_rate FROM TB_CTRT t WHERE t.CTRT_NO IN (SELECT CTRT_NO FROM d)

question: 위험점수 상위 25% 계약에서 보험금 청구가 발생한 비율
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT u.CTRT_NO FROM TB_UW u ORDER BY u.RISK_SCR DESC LIMIT (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 0.25 AS INTEGER) FROM TB_UW)) SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.CTRT_NO) AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q),0) AS clm_rate FROM TB_CLM c WHERE c.CTRT_NO IN (SELECT CTRT_NO FROM q)

question: 올해 월별 신계약 건수가 직전 달보다 늘어난 달은?
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(CTRT_DT,1,6) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_CTRT WHERE substr(CTRT_DT,1,4) = '2026' GROUP BY substr(CTRT_DT,1,6)) SELECT a.ym, a.cnt, b.cnt AS prev_cnt FROM m a JOIN m b ON CAST(b.ym AS INTEGER) = CAST(a.ym AS INTEGER) - 1 WHERE a.cnt > b.cnt ORDER BY a.ym

question: 청구금액 대비 지급률이 가장 낮은 청구 유형은?
gold_sql: SELECT cd.CD_NM AS typ, CAST(SUM(c.PAY_AMT) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(c.CLM_AMT),0) AS pay_ratio FROM TB_CLM c JOIN TB_COMM_CD cd ON cd.CD_GRP = 'CLM_TYP' AND cd.CD = c.CLM_TYP_CD GROUP BY cd.CD_NM ORDER BY pay_ratio ASC LIMIT 1

question: 올해 접수된 민원이 30건 미만인 지점을 적은 순으로 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT b.BRCH_NM, COUNT(k.TCKT_ID) AS cnt FROM TB_BRCH b LEFT JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.BRCH_CD = b.BRCH_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CTRT t ON t.AGNT_ID = a.AGNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CS_TCKT k ON k.CTRT_NO = t.CTRT_NO AND k.RCPT_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260824' GROUP BY b.BRCH_NM HAVING COUNT(k.TCKT_ID) < 30 ORDER BY cnt

question: 계약을 2건 이상 보유한 고객의 첫 계약과 마지막 계약 사이 평균 경과일수
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT CUST_ID, MIN(CTRT_DT) AS f, MAX(CTRT_DT) AS l FROM TB_CTRT GROUP BY CUST_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT AVG(julianday(substr(l,1,4) || '-' || substr(l,5,2) || '-' || substr(l,7,2)) - julianday(substr(f,1,4) || '-' || substr(f,5,2) || '-' || substr(f,7,2))) AS avg_days FROM x

question: 휴대전화번호가 010-1234-5678인 고객의 계약을 찾아줘
